pr_title: Fix admin queue page title and fix CI failures
pr_body:
* Fix #26408
* Bypass the data race issue in "ssh" package
* Test eventsource failure
pr_comments: Test failure likely unrelated - Data race in `TestGit/SSH`.

> Test failure likely unrelated - Data race in `TestGit/SSH`.

Already a PR:  Fix data race by using atomic value https://github.com/gliderlabs/ssh/pull/211
Ah, nice, I opened https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/26411 to track it.

Use a trick to bypass the upstream data race bug. d682e1032de83fec81f520d3f224ba9c6fff3a0c

Let's see whether it works.
Giving this a bit more time for other reviewers, but ultimately we should land it soon to eliminate the intermittent CI failures related to the race.
I guess it's better to land now to unblock other PRs.
I suspect the race has something to do with go1.21 which already runs on the ci because we specify `go-version: ">=1.20"`. Might wanna lock that down.

A new failure, I think it might be related to "speed up TestEventSourceManagerRun #26262": `EventSourceUpdateTime = time.Second`

```
--- FAIL: TestEventSourceManagerRun (31.56s)
    eventsource_test.go:83: 
        	Error Trace:	/home/runner/work/gitea/gitea/tests/integration/eventsource_test.go:83
        	Error:      	Condition never satisfied
        	Test:       	TestEventSourceManagerRun
```

I was unable to create a backport for 1.20. @wxiaoguang, please send one manually. :tea:

```
go run ./contrib/backport 26409
...  // fix git conflicts if any
go run ./contrib/backport --continue
```
